```text
2:<!-- Rules are numbered continuously 1-15 across the sections below; check.sh error
9:`./.claude-students/check.sh`.
13:1. **Upstream wins.** `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `docs/guidelines-*.md` are authoritative.
55:15. **`./.claude-students/check.sh` passes before you push [checked].** It is dependency-free and
58:## The guide layer (rules 16-22)
60:`guide/` holds a plain-English page for each reference page in `docs/`, same filename. It exists so
63:16. Every guide carries `source:`, `source-hash:` and `verified-at:` in its frontmatter **[checked]**.
64:17. A guide's `source:` names a real `docs/*.md` with the **same filename** **[checked]**.
66:    changes and the guide is not regenerated, `check.sh` reports **drift** **[checked]**. Regenerating
67:    means: reread the reference page, rewrite the guide, update the hash and `verified-at`.
68:19. Guide headings match `guide/_TEMPLATE.md` exactly and in order **[checked]**.
69:20. Guides are capped at **200 lines**, code fences at **30** **[checked]** — teaching needs more room
71:21. **A guide adds explanation, vocabulary and worked steps. It adds no new facts.** Every repo path
72:    a guide cites must also be cited by its source page **[checked]**. If you need a fact the
73:    reference page lacks, add it *there* first, which bumps the hash and forces the guide to be
74:    regenerated in the same commit — exactly the intended order.
75:22. `guide/START-HERE.md` has no source page. It is exempt from rules 17, 18 and 21, and is where
78:**Never fix a fact in `guide/`.** If the two layers disagree, the reference page is the truth and
79:the guide is stale: fix `docs/`, regenerate the guide, ship both in one PR. A disagreement is a bug
80:report against `docs/`, not an editing job in `guide/`.
---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Validates .claude-students against the mechanical rules in MAINTENANCE.md.
# Dependency-free. Run from anywhere: ./.claude-students/check.sh
set -uo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1

DIR=".claude-students"
TEMPLATE="$DIR/_TEMPLATE.md"
INDEX="$DIR/INDEX.md"
MAX_LINES=120
MAX_INDEX_LINES=60
MAX_FENCE=10

fail=0
err() {
  printf '%s: %s\n' "$1" "$2" >&2
  fail=1
}

for required in "$TEMPLATE" "$INDEX" "$DIR/MAINTENANCE.md" "$DIR/README.md"; do
  [ -f "$required" ] || err "$required" "missing"
done
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ] || exit 1

check_whitespace() {
  local file="$1" line
  line=$(grep -n '[[:space:]]$' "$file" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  [ -z "$line" ] || err "$file:$line" "trailing whitespace (rule 10)"
  [ -z "$(tail -c 1 "$file")" ] || err "$file" "no final newline (rule 10)"
}

for meta in "$TEMPLATE" "$INDEX" "$DIR/MAINTENANCE.md" "$DIR/README.md"; do
  check_whitespace "$meta"
done

want_h2=$(grep '^## ' "$TEMPLATE")

index_lines=$(wc -l < "$INDEX")
if [ "$index_lines" -gt "$MAX_INDEX_LINES" ]; then
  err "$INDEX" "$index_lines lines, cap is $MAX_INDEX_LINES (rule 6)"
fi

claimed=""
found_doc=0

for doc in "$DIR"/docs/*.md; do
  [ -e "$doc" ] || break
  found_doc=1
  name="${doc##*/}"

  lines=$(wc -l < "$doc")
  if [ "$lines" -gt "$MAX_LINES" ]; then
    err "$doc" "$lines lines, cap is $MAX_LINES - split it (rule 6)"
  fi

  check_whitespace "$doc"

  if [ "$(head -1 "$doc")" != "---" ]; then
    err "$doc:1" "must open with a --- frontmatter block (rule 5)"
```

```text
function initFooterLanguageMenu() {
  document.querySelector('.page-footer .menu.language-menu')?.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {

function initFooterThemeSelector() {
  const elDropdown = document.querySelector('#footer-theme-selector');

  const $dropdown = fomanticQuery(elDropdown);
  $dropdown.dropdown({
    direction: 'upward',
    apiSettings: {url: `${appSubUrl}/-/web-theme/list`, cache: false},
  });
  addDelegatedEventListener(elDropdown, 'click', '.menu > .item', async (el) => {
    const themeName = el.getAttribute('data-value')!;
    await POST(`${appSubUrl}/-/web-theme/apply?theme=${encodeURIComponent(themeName)}`);
    window.location.reload();
  });
}

package misc

import (
	"net/http"

	"gitea.dev/modules/optional"
	"gitea.dev/modules/templates"
	"gitea.dev/modules/util"
	"gitea.dev/modules/web/middleware"
	"gitea.dev/services/context"
	user_service "gitea.dev/services/user"
	"gitea.dev/services/webtheme"
)

func WebThemeList(ctx *context.Context) {
	curWebTheme := ctx.TemplateContext.CurrentWebTheme()
	renderUtils := templates.NewRenderUtils(ctx)
	allThemes := webtheme.GetAvailableThemes()

	var results []map[string]any
	for _, theme := range allThemes {
		results = append(results, map[string]any{
			"name":  renderUtils.RenderThemeItem(theme, 14),
			"value": theme.InternalName,
			"class": "item js-aria-clickable" + util.Iif(theme.InternalName == curWebTheme.InternalName, " selected", ""),
		})
	}
	ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"results": results})
}

func WebThemeApply(ctx *context.Context) {
	themeName := ctx.FormString("theme")
	if ctx.Doer != nil {
		opts := &user_service.UpdateOptions{Theme: optional.Some(themeName)}
		_ = user_service.UpdateUser(ctx, ctx.Doer, opts)
	} else {
		middleware.SetSiteCookie(ctx.Resp, middleware.CookieTheme, themeName, 0)
	}
}
```

```text
// for static dropdown elements (generated by server-side template), prepare them with necessary aria attributes
function attachStaticElements(dropdown: HTMLElement, focusable: HTMLElement, menu: HTMLElement) {
  // prepare static dropdown menu list popup
  if (!menu.id) {
    menu.id = generateElemId('_aria_dropdown_menu_');
  }

  $(menu).find('> .item, > .scrolling.menu > .item').each((_, item) => updateMenuItem(dropdown, item));

  // this role could only be changed after its content is ready, otherwise some browsers+readers (like Chrome+AppleVoice) crash
  menu.setAttribute('role', (dropdown as any)[ariaPatchKey].listPopupRole);
  if (dropdown.classList.contains('multiple')) menu.setAttribute('aria-multiselectable', 'true');
  refreshAriaSelected(dropdown);

  // prepare selection label items
  for (const label of dropdown.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.ui.label')) {
    updateSelectionLabel(label);
  }

  // make the primary element (focusable) aria-friendly
  focusable.setAttribute('role', focusable.getAttribute('role') ?? (dropdown as any)[ariaPatchKey].focusableRole);
  focusable.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', (dropdown as any)[ariaPatchKey].listPopupRole);
  focusable.setAttribute('aria-controls', menu.id);
  focusable.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

  // use tooltip's content as aria-label if there is no aria-label
  const tooltipContent = dropdown.getAttribute('data-tooltip-content');
  if (tooltipContent && !dropdown.getAttribute('aria-label')) {
    dropdown.setAttribute('aria-label', tooltipContent);
  }
}

function attachInitElements(dropdown: HTMLElement) {
  (dropdown as any)[ariaPatchKey] = {};

  // Dropdown has 2 different focusing behaviors
  // * with search input: the input is focused, and it works with aria-activedescendant pointing another sibling element.
  // * without search input (but the readonly text), the dropdown itself is focused. then the aria-activedescendant points to the element inside dropdown
  // Some desktop screen readers may change the focus, but dropdown requires that the focus must be on its primary element, then they don't work well.

  // Expected user interactions for dropdown with aria support:
  // * user can use Tab to focus in the dropdown, then the dropdown menu (list) will be shown
  // * user presses Tab on the focused dropdown to move focus to next sibling focusable element (but not the menu item)
  // * user can use arrow key Up/Down to navigate between menu items
  // * when user presses Enter:
  //    - if the menu item is clickable (eg: <a>), then trigger the click event
  //    - otherwise, the dropdown control (low-level code) handles the Enter event, hides the dropdown menu

  // TODO: multiple selection is only partially supported. Check and test them one by one in the future.

  const textSearch = dropdown.querySelector<HTMLElement>('input.search');
  const focusable = textSearch || dropdown; // the primary element for focus, see comment above
  if (!focusable) return;

  // as a combobox, the input should not have autocomplete by default
  if (textSearch && !textSearch.getAttribute('autocomplete')) {
    textSearch.setAttribute('autocomplete', 'off');
  }

  let menu = $(dropdown).find('> .menu')[0];
  if (!menu) {
    // some "multiple selection" dropdowns don't have a static menu element in HTML, we need to pre-create it to make it have correct aria attributes
    menu = document.createElement('div');
    menu.classList.add('menu');
    dropdown.append(menu);
  }

  // There are 2 possible solutions about the role: combobox or menu.
  // The idea is that if there is an input, then it's a combobox, otherwise it's a menu.
  // Since #19861 we have prepared the "combobox" solution, but didn't get enough time to put it into practice and test before.
  const isComboBox = dropdown.querySelectorAll('input').length > 0;

  (dropdown as any)[ariaPatchKey].focusableRole = isComboBox ? 'combobox' : 'menu';
  (dropdown as any)[ariaPatchKey].listPopupRole = isComboBox ? 'listbox' : '';
  (dropdown as any)[ariaPatchKey].listItemRole = isComboBox ? 'option' : 'menuitem';

  attachDomEvents(dropdown, focusable, menu);
  attachStaticElements(dropdown, focusable, menu);
}
```

````markdown
# Plan — #64 Accessible names for icon-only dropdown triggers

## Context

Issue #64 (sub-issue of #25, small, 2 pts, Sprint 1, due **today, Oct 8 11:59 PM**). Screen readers
announce icon-only Fomantic dropdown triggers as just "menu, collapsed". The issue's Design Decision
is: put localised `aria-label`s in the templates, and add a **dev-only console warning** in
`dropdown.ts` for any dropdown left without a name. It does **not** synthesise a name in JS.

State of `origin/main` (local main is 34 commits behind, so pull first):
- **AC2 is already met.** #62 migrated `templates/repo/issue/view_content/context_menu.tmpl` to
  `<aria-menu>` with `aria-label="{{ctx.Locale.Tr "repo.more_operations"}}"`, and the spec reviewer
  said to drop AC2. Leave the template alone and note this in the PR and the issue.
- **AC3 is still open.** `#footer-theme-selector` in `templates/base/footer_content.tmpl` is still a
  Fomantic `ui dropdown custom`, initialised by `initFooterThemeSelector` in
  `web_src/js/features/common-page.ts`. It shows icon, theme name and icon, but `dropdown.ts` gives
  it `role="menu"`, and a menu takes its name **only** from `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`, never
  from its text. Fix: `aria-label="{{ctx.Locale.Tr "settings.ui"}}"` ("Theme", an existing key).
- The tooltip fallback for AC4 already exists in `attachStaticElements`
  (`web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.ts`, lines ~146-150 on main).
- The repo's dev-only switch is `window.config.runModeIsProd`, used in `modules/errors.ts` and
  `features/common-button.ts`. `vitest.setup.ts` sets it to `true`, so existing tests stay silent.

## Steps

### 0. Branch
```bash
git switch main && git pull origin main
git switch -c feat/issue-64-dropdown-accessible-names
```

### 1. Dev-only warning — `web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.ts`
Add a small helper next to `attachStaticElements` and call it right after the existing tooltip
fallback:

```ts
// role=menu takes no name from its content, but a trigger with visible text is at least not icon-only
function hasAccessibleName(dropdown: HTMLElement, focusable: HTMLElement): boolean {
  for (const el of [dropdown, focusable]) {
    if (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || el.getAttribute('title')) return true;
  }
  if ((focusable as HTMLInputElement).labels?.length) return true; // a search input with <label for>
  for (const node of dropdown.childNodes) {
    if (node instanceof Element && node.matches('.menu, select')) continue; // popup items and a wrapped <select>'s options are not the trigger
    if (node.textContent.trim() || (node instanceof Element && node.querySelector('img[alt]:not([alt=""])'))) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
```
In `attachStaticElements`, after the tooltip block:
```ts
  if (!window.config.runModeIsProd && !hasAccessibleName(dropdown, focusable)) {
    console.warn('Dropdown trigger has no accessible name, add an aria-label in its template:', dropdown);
  }
```
This runs once per element (`attachInitElements` is guarded by `ariaPatchKey`), it adds nothing at
runtime in production, and it never writes a name (that is the issue's Design Decision).

### 2. Templates
- `templates/base/footer_content.tmpl`: add `aria-label="{{ctx.Locale.Tr "settings.ui"}}"` to
  `#footer-theme-selector` (AC3).
- Icon-only dropdowns from the audit: TBD (see Audit below).

### 3. Unit tests — `web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.test.ts` (AC6)
Add a new `describe('dropdown accessible names', {concurrent: false}, ...)` block. It mutates
`window.config.runModeIsProd` and spies on `console.warn`, and the vitest config sets
`sequence.concurrent: true`, so the block must not run concurrently. Restore both in `afterEach`,
clear `document.body`, and use a small `createIconDropdown(attrs)` helper (an `{{svg}}`-like
`<svg>` plus a `.menu`).
- **AC1:** an icon-only dropdown with `aria-label` in its markup still has a non-empty
  `aria-label` after `$(el).dropdown()`. An icon-only dropdown with only `data-tooltip-content`
  gets `aria-label` equal to the tooltip.
- **AC4:** `aria-label="Theme"` plus `data-tooltip-content="Other"` keeps `aria-label="Theme"`.
- **AC5:** with `runModeIsProd = false`, an unnamed icon-only dropdown calls `console.warn` once
  with the element as an argument. With `runModeIsProd = true`, the same markup produces no
  warning. With dev mode on, a named dropdown, a tooltip-only dropdown and a dropdown with
  visible text produce no warning.

### 4. Docs
- `web_src/js/modules/fomantic/aria.md`, under "Fomantic Dropdown": add a short paragraph saying an
````

```text
test('comment menu is operable by keyboard', async ({page, request}) => {
  const repoName = `e2e-comment-menu-${randomString(8)}`;
  const owner = env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_USER;
  await apiCreateRepo(request, {name: repoName, autoInit: false});
  await Promise.all([
    apiCreateIssue(request, {owner, repo: repoName, title: 'Comment menu test', body: 'the issue body'}),
    login(page),
  ]);
  await page.goto(`/${owner}/${repoName}/issues/1`);
  const trigger = page.getByRole('button', {name: 'More Operations'}).first();

  await trigger.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Copy Link'})).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  // the browser's clipboard permission decides the text
  const tooltip = page.locator('.tippy-box').filter({hasText: /Copied|Copy failed/});
  await expect(tooltip).toBeVisible();
  const [tipBox, triggerBox] = [(await tooltip.boundingBox())!, (await trigger.boundingBox())!];
  expect(Math.abs(tipBox.y - triggerBox.y)).toBeLessThan(80);
  expect(Math.abs(tipBox.x - triggerBox.x)).toBeLessThan(300);
  await expect(trigger).toBeFocused();

  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowUp');
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Copy Link'})).toBeHidden();
  await expect(trigger).toBeFocused();

  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
  await page.keyboard.press('e');
  await expect(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Edit'})).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(page.locator('.edit-content-zone textarea')).toHaveValue('the issue body');
  await assertNoJsError(page);
});
```

## Counts

| Category | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| NAMED | 11 | `aria-label` (3): `filter_actions.tmpl:10`, `issue/view_content.tmpl:114`, `add_reaction.tmpl:2`. `data-tooltip-content` (8): `branch/list.tmpl:48,180`, `diff/options_dropdown.tmpl:1`, `diff/whitespace_dropdown.tmpl:1`, `filter_item_user_fetch.tmpl:9`, `repo/view_content.tmpl:92`, `shared/search/combo.tmpl:18`, `devtest/fomantic-dropdown.tmpl:6` |
| TEXT | 119 | Text comes from `.text` divs, `ctx.Locale.Tr` strings, branch, user and team names, and avatar plus `ShortName` (owner pickers in `migrate/*` ×9, `pulls/fork`, `dashboard/navbar`) |
| ICON-ONLY | 7 | 5 production, 1 Vue placeholder, 1 devtest |
| SELECT/COMBO | 39 | 12 `<select class="ui dropdown">`, 3 `.ui.dropdown.selection` wrapping a `<select>` (`settings/options.tmpl:457,564,632`), 24 with the `search` class (`input.search`) |

- **SELECT/COMBO labels:** none of the 39 has an `aria-label` or a `<label for=…>`. Most have a sibling `<label>` with no `for`, so it isn't programmatically linked. These have no label at all: `admin/packages/list.tmpl:17`, `package/shared/list.tmpl:6`, `package/shared/versionlist.tmpl:11,18` and `home_sidebar_top.tmpl:33` (topics).
- **Combobox role:** `dropdown.ts` picks combobox when the dropdown contains *any* `<input>`, hidden ones included. So most TEXT selection dropdowns with a hidden input also get role=combobox on the dropdown element.

## Borderline cases (counted as TEXT)

- **Footer theme selector** (`templates/base/footer_content.tmpl:25`): visible text, but it is only the current theme's name, never the purpose ("Theme").
  - **What `RenderThemeItem` renders** (`modules/templates/util_render.go:234`): `<div class="theme-menu-item" data-tooltip-content="{description}">{icon} {DisplayName} {extraIcon}</div>`. The icon is sun, moon, eclipse or paintbrush. `DisplayName` comes from the CSS variable `--theme-display-name`, falling back to the internal name.
  - **Why the tooltip doesn't help:** the tooltip sits on the inner div, not on the `.ui.dropdown`. `dropdown.ts` only copies `data-tooltip-content` from the dropdown element, so it never becomes the accessible name.
  - **How it's initialised:** the element has the `custom` class, so the global `.ui.dropdown:not(.custom)` init in `web_src/js/features/common-page.ts:63` skips it. `initFooterThemeSelector()` (`common-page.ts:40-53`) calls `.dropdown({direction:'upward', apiSettings:{url: appSubUrl + '/-/web-theme/list'}})` itself, so the ARIA patch still applies (role=menu).
  - **The menu:** items come from `routers/web/misc/webtheme.go` `WebThemeList` (`RenderThemeItem` at size 14, class `item js-aria-clickable`). Clicking one POSTs to `/-/web-theme/apply` and reloads.
  - **Fix:** `settings.ui` = "Theme" (l.694) is an existing key that could serve as an `aria-label` or tooltip.
- **Selection dropdowns with an empty `.text` or `default text`:** they show nothing until Fomantic fills the text from the hidden input's value, and their labels aren't linked.
  - `repo/issue/sidebar/issue_management.tmpl:55` (lock reason): `name="reason"` has no value and the first menu item is blank, so the trigger stays empty until the user picks one. Only a nearby `<strong>` describes it.
  - `repo/issue/fields/dropdown.tmpl:4`: empty `default text`. With no default value it stays empty, and the field's title is an `<h3>`, not a label.
  - Filled from a preset value: `repo/settings/webhook/gitea.tmpl:11,23`, `gogs.tmpl:11`, `matrix.tmpl:14`, `user/settings/appearance.tmpl:18`, `user/settings/notifications.tmpl:12,42`, `repo/create.tmpl:14`. Same pattern: `repo/settings/options.tmpl:600` (counted under SELECT/COMBO).
- **Value-only text:** branch selectors, language pickers and the collaborator access mode show only the current value. Each has an unlinked label or heading nearby.
- No dropdown triggers whose text is only an emoji or a number turned up (`add_reaction.tmpl:2` is a smiley icon, but it is named via `aria-label`). None hide their text on mobile (I checked for `not-mobile`/`only-mobile`/`sr-only`).

````markdown
# Plan — #64 Accessible names for icon-only dropdown triggers

## Context

Issue #64 (sub-issue of #25, small, 2 pts, Sprint 1, due **today, Oct 8 11:59 PM**). Screen readers
announce icon-only Fomantic dropdown triggers as just "menu, collapsed". The issue's Design Decision
is to put localised `aria-label`s in the templates and add a **dev-only console warning** in
`dropdown.ts` for any dropdown left without a name. It does **not** synthesise a name in JS.

State of `main` (`ffc5050a23`, now pulled locally):
- **AC2 is already met.** #62 turned `templates/repo/issue/view_content/context_menu.tmpl` into an
  `<aria-menu>` with `aria-label="{{ctx.Locale.Tr "repo.more_operations"}}"`, and the spec reviewer
  said to drop AC2. Leave the template alone.
- **AC3 is still open.** `#footer-theme-selector` (`templates/base/footer_content.tmpl`) is still a
  Fomantic `ui dropdown custom`, set up by `initFooterThemeSelector` in
  `web_src/js/features/common-page.ts`. Its visible text is only the current theme's name, and
  `dropdown.ts` gives it `role="menu"`. A menu gets its name only from
  `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`, so the text never names it.
- AC4's tooltip fallback already exists in `attachStaticElements`
  (`web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.ts`, around lines 180-184).
- The dev-only switch in this repo is `window.config.runModeIsProd`, used in `modules/errors.ts` and
  `features/common-button.ts`. `web_src/js/vitest.setup.ts` sets it to `true`, so existing tests
  stay silent.

**Audit (answers the issue's Open Question):** `templates/` has 176 Fomantic dropdowns: 11 named,
119 with visible text, 39 select or search comboboxes, and 7 icon-only. Of the 7, 5 are in
production, 1 is a devtest demo, and 1 is a Vue placeholder with no `.menu` that `custom` keeps out
of Fomantic init and `DiffCommitSelector.vue` replaces with a named control. Two more selection
dropdowns have an empty `.text` until a value is picked, so they count as icon-only when they
initialise. That is few enough to fix them all here, with no follow-up split.

## Steps

### 0. Branch
```bash
git switch -c feat/issue-64-dropdown-accessible-names
```

### 1. Dev-only warning — `web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.ts`
Add a helper next to `attachStaticElements`:
```ts
// role=menu takes no name from its content, but a trigger with visible text is at least not icon-only
function hasAccessibleName(dropdown: HTMLElement, focusable: HTMLElement): boolean {
  for (const el of [dropdown, focusable]) {
    if (['aria-label', 'aria-labelledby', 'title', 'placeholder'].some((attr) => el.getAttribute(attr))) return true;
  }
  if ((focusable as HTMLInputElement).labels?.length) return true; // a search input with <label for>
  for (const node of dropdown.childNodes) {
    if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent!.trim()) return true;
    if (!(node instanceof Element) || node.matches('.menu, select')) continue; // popup items and a wrapped <select>'s options are not the trigger
    if (node.textContent.trim() || node.matches('img[alt]:not([alt=""])') || node.querySelector('img[alt]:not([alt=""])')) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
```
Call it in `attachStaticElements` right after the existing tooltip block:
```ts
  if (!window.config.runModeIsProd && !hasAccessibleName(dropdown, focusable)) {
    console.warn('Dropdown trigger has no accessible name, add an aria-label in its template:', dropdown);
  }
```
`attachInitElements` is guarded by `ariaPatchKey`, so the check runs once per element. Passing the
element to `console.warn` makes it clickable in devtools ("names the element", AC5). In production
the check is skipped and no name is ever written.

### 2. Templates
Add `aria-label` to the `.ui.dropdown` element:

| Template | Name |
| --- | --- |
| `templates/base/footer_content.tmpl` (`#footer-theme-selector`, AC3) | `settings.ui` ("Theme") |
| `templates/repo/actions/runs_list.tmpl` (run kebab) | `repo.more_operations` |
| `templates/repo/actions/list.tmpl` (workflow kebab, a `<button>`) | `repo.more_operations` |
| `templates/projects/view.tmpl` (column kebab) | `repo.more_operations` |
| `templates/package/shared/cleanup_rules/list.tmpl` (rule kebab) | `repo.more_operations` |
| `templates/repo/issue/view_content/update_branch_by_merge.tmpl` (split button caret) | **new** `repo.pulls.update_branch_choose` |
| `templates/repo/issue/sidebar/issue_management.tmpl` (lock reason, empty `.text`) | `repo.issues.lock.reason` |
| `templates/repo/issue/fields/dropdown.tmpl` (issue form field, empty `default text`) | `{{.item.Attributes.label}}` |
| `templates/devtest/fomantic-dropdown.tmpl` (split button demo) | literal `"More options"` (devtest pages use English) |

- New key in `options/locale/locale_en-US.json`, next to `repo.pulls.update_branch_rebase`:
  `"repo.pulls.update_branch_choose": "Choose how to update the branch"`. It mirrors
  `repo.issues.close_reason.choose`, which the sibling split buttons use. Edit only the en-US file.
- Use `aria-label`, not `data-tooltip-content`, as the Design Decision says, and to match
  `filter_actions.tmpl`/`context_menu.tmpl`.
- Not touched: `repo/diff/box.tmpl` (the Vue placeholder above) and the 39 select/combobox
  dropdowns with labels that aren't linked to them. Those are a separate problem (a `<label>`
  without `for`), out of scope, and worth a follow-up issue.

### 3. Unit tests — `web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.test.ts` (AC6)
Add a new `describe('dropdown accessible names', {concurrent: false}, ...)`. The vitest config
sets `sequence.concurrent: true`, and this block flips `window.config.runModeIsProd` and spies on
`console.warn`. `beforeEach`: `vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {})`.
`afterEach`: restore the mocks, set `runModeIsProd = true`, and run
`document.body.replaceChildren()`. A helper `createIconDropdown(attrs = '')` appends
`<div class="ui dropdown" ${attrs}><svg class="svg octicon-kebab-horizontal"></svg><div class="menu"><div class="item">x</div></div></div>`
and calls `$(el).dropdown()`.
- **AC1:** an icon dropdown with `aria-label` keeps a non-empty name after init. One with only
  `data-tooltip-content` gets `aria-label` equal to the tooltip.
- **AC4:** `aria-label="Theme" data-tooltip-content="Other"` keeps `aria-label="Theme"`.
- **AC5:** with `runModeIsProd = false`, an unnamed icon dropdown makes exactly one
  `console.warn` call whose arguments include the element. With `runModeIsProd = true` there is no
  call. With dev mode on, an aria-label, a tooltip only, visible text, and an `input.search` with
  `<label for>` each produce no warning.

### 3b. E2E check for AC3 — `tests/e2e/menus.test.ts`
This needs no login, so it stays well under 2s:
```ts
test('footer theme selector has an accessible name', async ({page}) => {
  await page.goto('/');
  await expect(page.getByRole('menu', {name: 'Theme'})).toBeVisible();
  await assertNoJsError(page);
});
```

### 4. Docs — `web_src/js/modules/fomantic/aria.md`
Under "Fomantic Dropdown", add a short paragraph. It says an icon-only trigger needs a localised
`aria-label` (or `data-tooltip-content`) in its template, and that a non-prod `RUN_MODE` logs a
console warning for any dropdown whose trigger has no name and no visible text. Leave
`.claude-students/docs` unchanged: `frontend-js.md` already links to `aria.md` and is at 118 of
its 120-line cap.

### 5. Drafts for Jack to review and post
- **Issue #64 body edit:** strike AC2 and note "met by #62 (`repo.more_operations`)". Answer the
  Open Question with the audit counts above. Add the update-branch locale key as `### Decision 2`
  only if wanted. It's minor, so it can stay in the PR.
- **PR:** title `feat(a11y): name icon-only dropdown triggers (#64)`. Use the
  `COURSE-WORKFLOW.md` sections: Closes #64, What changed, Why (AC by AC, with AC2 met by #62),
  Test strategy (unit for AC1/4/5, e2e for AC3, manual dev-mode console check), CI/manual, Design
  (points at the issue), and AI assistance with no log link.
- **AI Assistance issue comment** (Role: Implementation) for Jack to post, with a log link under
  `ai-logs/sprint1/Jack-Donohue/`.
- Remind Jack: `specstory sync`, then file the log as
  `2026-10-08_claude-code_issue-64-impl.md`, copying and renaming only.

## Verification
- `pnpm exec vitest web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.test.ts`
- `make lint-js`, `make lint-templates`, `make lint-json`
- `GITEA_TEST_E2E_FLAGS='tests/e2e/menus.test.ts' make test-e2e`
- `./.claude-students/check.sh`
- Manual: set `RUN_MODE = dev` in `custom/conf/app.ini` (now `prod`; revert afterwards), run
  Gitea, then open the home page, an Actions run list, a project board, a PR that is behind its
  base, and the lock-issue modal. Check that the console shows no "no accessible name" warnings,
  and that devtools' accessibility pane shows names such as "Theme" and "More Operations".
  Temporarily removing one `aria-label` should produce the warning.
- Commits need Jack's explicit approval each time, plus the trailer
  `Assisted-by: claude-code:claude-opus-5-5`, and no Co-Authored-By or Signed-off-by.
````

```text
+// role=menu takes no name from its content, but a trigger with visible text is at least not icon-only
+function hasAccessibleName(dropdown: HTMLElement, focusable: HTMLElement): boolean {
+  for (const el of [dropdown, focusable]) {
+    if (['aria-label', 'aria-labelledby', 'title', 'placeholder'].some((attr) => el.getAttribute(attr))) return true;
+  }
+  if ((focusable as HTMLInputElement).labels?.length) return true; // a search input with <label for>
+  for (const node of dropdown.childNodes) {
+    if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && node.textContent!.trim()) return true;
+    if (!(node instanceof Element) || node.matches('.menu, select')) continue; // popup items and a wrapped <select>'s options are not the trigger
+    if (node.textContent.trim() || node.matches('img[alt]:not([alt=""])') || node.querySelector('img[alt]:not([alt=""])')) return true;
+  }
+  return false;
```

I've implemented #64 on a new branch, `feat/issue-64-dropdown-accessible-names`, and every automated check passes. Nothing is committed yet: I need your OK first, and there's one manual check left for you.

**What changed**
- **The warning (AC5):** in [dropdown.ts](web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.ts#L181-L199), when `RUN_MODE` isn't `prod`, a dropdown whose trigger has no name and no visible text logs one console warning that includes the element. It never writes a name, and production skips the check entirely.
- **AC2 needed no change.** #62 already made the comment menu an `<aria-menu>` named "More Operations".
- **Templates:** before writing labels, I listed every Fomantic dropdown in `templates/`. There are 176, and few enough are icon-only that I fixed them all here rather than splitting into a follow-up issue. I added an `aria-label` to:

Written for: your teammate reviewers and the course graders. Please read and edit these before posting.

**PR** — title: `feat(a11y): name icon-only dropdown triggers (#64)`

```markdown
Closes #64

## What changed
- `web_src/js/modules/fomantic/dropdown.ts`: outside `RUN_MODE = prod`, a Fomantic dropdown whose trigger has no accessible name and no visible text logs a console warning that includes the element. Nothing is added to the page, and production skips the check.
- Localised `aria-label`s on every icon-only dropdown trigger in `templates/`: the footer theme selector ("Theme"), the Actions run, Actions workflow, project column and package cleanup rule menus ("More Operations"), the PR update-branch split button (new key `repo.pulls.update_branch_choose`), the lock-reason and issue-form dropdowns (blank until a value is picked), and the devtest demo.
- `web_src/js/modules/fomantic/aria.md`: documents the rule and the warning.

## Why
Screen readers announced these triggers as only "menu, collapsed".
- AC1: every icon-only trigger now has a localised name in its template.
- AC2: already met by #62 (the comment menu is an `<aria-menu>` labelled `repo.more_operations`), so that template is unchanged.
- AC3: the footer theme selector is named "Theme". Its visible text is only the current theme, and a `role="menu"` element never takes its name from its content.
- AC4: an existing `aria-label` is kept, and the `data-tooltip-content` fallback still applies.
- AC5: the dev-only warning above.

Audit (the issue's open question): 176 Fomantic dropdowns in `templates/`. 7 are icon-only: 5 in production, 1 devtest demo, and 1 Vue placeholder that `DiffCommitSelector.vue` replaces with a named control. 2 more selection dropdowns stay blank until a value is picked. All the production ones are fixed here.

## How it was tested / Test strategy
- Unit, `dropdown.test.ts` (8 new tests): a template name survives init (AC1); an existing aria-label isn't overwritten and the tooltip fallback still works (AC4); an unnamed icon trigger warns exactly once in dev and never in prod, and triggers named by aria-label, tooltip, visible text or a linked `<label>` don't warn (AC5).
- Breaking the label check, the warning, or the prod guard each fails exactly the matching test.
- E2E, `menus.test.ts`: the footer has a `menu` named "Theme" (AC3), in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
- Not automated: that each changed template renders its label on its page. Checked by hand (below).

## CI / manual verification
- `pnpm exec vitest`: 58 files, 327 tests pass
- `make lint-js`, `make lint-templates`, `./.claude-students/check.sh`: pass. The locale JSON lints clean; `make lint-json` only flags the gitignored local `data/indexers/` file.
- `GITEA_TEST_E2E_FLAGS='tests/e2e/menus.test.ts' make test-e2e`: 14 passed, 1 skip that was already there (WebKit Tab)

## Design
Follows the Design Decision in #64: names live in the templates, plus a dev-only warning, and no name is made up in JS. The warning counts visible text as a name, since otherwise all 119 dropdowns with text would warn. Comboboxes whose `<label>` isn't linked to them are left for a follow-up issue.

## AI assistance
Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5) audited the templates, drafted the warning, the template labels and the tests, and ran the lint, unit and e2e checks. I reviewed every line, re-ran the checks, checked the pages by hand in dev mode, and can explain each change. AI log: see the AI Assistance comment on the linked issue.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-08 23:23:46Z)**_

The easiest way is the `GITEA_RUN_MODE` environment variable. It overrides `RUN_MODE` in `app.ini` (`modules/setting/setting.go:169`), so there's no file to edit or change back afterwards:

```bash
GITEA_RUN_MODE=dev ./gitea web
```

- **No rebuild needed:** the e2e run rebuilt `./gitea` and the frontend after my changes, so they're up to date. If you change anything, run `make build` first.
- **Using `make watch` instead:** run `GITEA_RUN_MODE=dev make watch`.
- **Permanent alternative:** change line 4 of `custom/conf/app.ini` from `RUN_MODE = prod` to `RUN_MODE = dev`, then restart. Remember to change it back.

To confirm it worked, run `window.config.runModeIsProd` in the browser console; it should print `false`. Then visit the pages and look for any "Dropdown trigger has no accessible name" warnings. To see the warning fire, delete an `aria-label` in devtools and reload. That won't work: the check runs only when the page loads, so devtools edits are lost on reload. Instead, temporarily remove one `aria-label` from a template, restart, check the console, and put it back.
